# Huītzilōpōchtli at work: solar & renewable energy, aviation & aerospace, and the myths that got there first
The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Huītzilōpōchtli** works now.

Huītzilōpōchtli's mythology is inseparable from the origin story of the Mexica people. He is the divine ancestor who led the migration, chose the site of Tenochtitlan, and defeated the lunar forces arrayed against his mother at Coatepec.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Huītzilōpōchtli
- **Pantheon:** Nahuatl
- **Domain of influence:** Sun, War, Hummingbird
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Technology & Innovation · Commerce & Governance
- **Strongest seat:** Solar & Renewable Energy
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 111 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Birth at Coatepec.** Cōātlīcue conceived Huītzilōpōchtli when a ball of feathers fell into her lap while she swept on Coatepec, 'Serpent Mountain. ' Her daughter Coyolxāuhqui and the four hundred Centzōn Huītznāhua attacked their mother in rage. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Journey from Aztlān.** The Mexica left their ancestral home of Aztlān under Huītzilōpōchtli's guidance.  The god spoke through priests and signs, instructing the people to call themselves Mēxihcah and to search for an eagle perched on a cactus devouring a snake. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Solar & Renewable Energy

*Photovoltaics, solar thermal, and the light economy. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The southern sun in hummingbird form, whose daily rising the Mexica fed with hearts — solar power as imperial theology.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Aviation & Aerospace

*Flight, aerospace engineering, and the sky economy. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

*His name means 'left-handed hummingbird' and the hummingbird is his warrior-soul form; nature's only sustained-hover flier as the emblem of a solar war god.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Mapping & Geospatial

*Maps, GIS, and location intelligence. (Sector: Technology & Innovation)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *He guided the Mexica migration from Aztlān by signs for two centuries, to the eagle-marked island of Tenochtitlan; sacred wayfinding at continental scale.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The hummingbird warrior who led the Mexica campaigns.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Huītzilōpōchtli's mythology is inseparable from the origin story of the Mexica people. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). ## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in solar & renewable energy, aviation & aerospace, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/huitzilopochtli/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
